assumptions.basis: model default 389.92 mg equals 500 mg HCl expressed as free base; clinical doses are the HCl salt
assumptions.description: the stated oral doses are metformin HCl; the model's dose input is free base

alternatives: the declared 3600*10^2 seconds, under which every area and every time to peak is a hundred times the paper's
assumptions.basis: the dynamics settle it: 26 of the 30 Tmax claims and the whole AUC24 column reproduce over a run of 24 model time units, which under the declared unit would be 2400 hours — and the other four times to peak are unjudged for the sampling grid rather than disagreeing. Every quantity with a time dimension rests on this reading — an area, which carries the clock as a factor, and a time to peak, which is the clock — and no peak height does. The T1/2 column is not evidence either way: a terminal slope of this run gives one number for four tissues the paper prints four for, so whatever it is fitted over is not stated
assumptions.chosen: read the declared time unit as an error and take the model's time to be hours
assumptions.closed_by: correct the model's `time` unitDefinition — it needs multiplier=3600 scale=0 for an hour, and declares multiplier=3600 scale=2, which SBML reads as one hundred of them. Nothing in the paper's text can clear this; the file is what states it
assumptions.description: the deposited model declares its time unit as 3600*10^2 seconds — one hundred hours — where its paper's tables are in hours
